technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with short-term bullish technicals (RSI14 rising, supertrend, hull) offset by price trading below key moving averages and negative volume indicators; moderate confluence but lacks strong directional confirmation.

fundamental.summary: LUV shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings 13 days away.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (20 VIX equivalent) presents contrarian buy opportunity despite weak congressional selling and absent news confirmation; market sentiment heavily bearish (56% bearish) suggests capitulation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (343.2), strong dollar headwind, CPI event just occurred, and earnings binary in 13 days create compounded downside risk for LUV.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI14 rising, supertrend bullish, and hull bullish with extreme fear sentiment (contrarian buy signal) suggest short-term momentum reversal potential near support at 28.83.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trading below all key moving averages (EMA21, EMA50, SMA50), negative volume (CMF, AO), zero fundamental support, earnings binary in 13 days, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and no active strategy triggers create compounded downside risk that outweighs technical bounce signals.
